source.name: Official Bedrock server: stored 512 × 512 area at Y64
source.evidence: Official BDS 1.26.61.1 build 53069370; same verified exact seed and Experiments-off temporary test world. Generated and saved 1024 chunks with temporary Y319 barriers immediately restored. Decoded stopped DB copy: 262144 cells at Y64, X/Z -256..255. All 1024 chunk-center Script API biome samples match decoded cells, with stone_beach/stony_shore as equivalent ID25 labels. Remaining cells were decoded, not individually API checked. Ocean, river and cold_ocean numeric names were directly observed at chunk centers. Retains 36 native locator landmarks, Y unknown, without claiming exhaustive structures. No approved global prediction engine; older Xbox chunks may differ.
